issues.issue: Was the Tribunal's finding that the review request was improperly made due to late follow-up copy reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Tribunal erred in concluding the review request was improperly made; procedural fairness breach alleged.
issues.respondent_position: Tribunal found request invalid due to late follow-up copy, relying on strict deadlines and prior decisions.
issues.result_text: Decision unreasonable as Tribunal failed to consider text, context and purpose of subsection 14(3) per Vavilov.
